flags.message: context.distribution_count is 2, but the first distribution (Jun 09 2026, for the 6/25 conference) was superseded by the Court's Jun 23 'Response Requested' order before the petition was considered, and the second (Sep 09, for the 9/28 long conference) is the first distribution with full briefing. The petition has therefore never been relisted in the classic sense; a reader of the relist-count cut should treat this docket as a response-requested, first-consideration petition rather than a once-relisted one. My relist-increment claim is stated from the frozen count of 2 as the contract requires.

Forward cell; no outcome exists (conference is 9/28/2026). Live CourtListener docket entries for this docket returned zero rows (SCOTUS dockets carry no RECAP entries), so the supremecourt.gov snapshot was the only docket source. A web search surfaced only pre-snapshot news coverage of the petition and BIO, no disposition.
